# Style Guide

> The coding conventions every repo in the hanzoai, zooai and luxfi estate
> follows. Brand-neutral on purpose: one set of conventions across the estate.
> Dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0, so an agent may copy any of it
> into a repo's own instructions without ceremony or attribution.

Read these in full — each is short enough to finish, and a guide nobody
finishes governs nothing.

## Guides

- [Commits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/git.md): the message, what a branch is for
- [Naming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/naming.md): first principles, no compound words, one name per concept
- [Comments and documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/prose.md): what code does, not how it got here
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/architecture.md): one way, addresses, what you do not build
- [TypeScript and the web](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/typescript.md): the component layer, tokens, packages
- [Go](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/go.md): the driver, the ORM, typed ops, identity
- [Whitespace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/whitespace.md): indent width by language, and who decides it

## Optional

- [Guide for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/AGENTS.md): what belongs in this repo and what does not
- [Licence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/LICENSE): CC0 1.0 Universal
